resources.string: Messages by MMS that only the person you write to can read: locked for the key their phone number means, signed by yours. No account, no server of ours — the phone network carries them and cannot open them.\n\nThis application holds no key and does no cryptography: it asks foodjis, which must be installed.
To find the PGP messages among the MMS this phone has received, this application needs to read them. It opens nothing else.
The message is locked for the certificate that carries this number among your foodjis contacts. Signing asks for your security key.
